manual_entries.title: ProteinGym: Large-Scale Benchmarks for Protein Fitness Prediction and Design
manual_entries.abstract: ProteinGym is a large, experimentally grounded benchmark suite for protein mutation fitness prediction and design, spanning deep-mutational-scanning assays and clinical variants.
manual_entries.body: [[SECTION Benchmark scope]] We introduce ProteinGym as a biology benchmark suite grounded in experimental mutation effects for protein fitness prediction and design. [[SECTION Reproducibility]] The public repository provides datasets, evaluation code, model scores, and versioned releases.

manual_entries.title: BioMysteryBench: Evaluating Bioinformatics Research Capabilities
manual_entries.abstract: BioMysteryBench evaluates agents on verifiable, open-ended bioinformatics investigations over real scientific datasets with objective biological answers.
manual_entries.body: [[SECTION Benchmarking models on verifiable biological tasks]] We introduce BioMysteryBench, a biology research agent benchmark with 99 expert-authored bioinformatics problems. Tasks use real datasets, objective ground truth, validation notebooks, tool use, database retrieval, and repeated trials. The public dataset is a preview rather than the complete benchmark.

manual_entries.title: LifeSciBench: Evaluating Language Models on Realistic, Expert-Level Tasks in the Life Sciences
manual_entries.abstract: LifeSciBench contains 750 expert-authored tasks across applied life-science workflows, with heterogeneous artifacts and task-specific grading rubrics.
manual_entries.body: [[PAGE 1]] We introduce LifeSciBench, a life science benchmark of 750 expert-authored tasks for realistic research work. [[PAGE 2]] The evaluation includes evidence synthesis, research design, troubleshooting, figures, tables, sequence files, molecular structures, and source-grounded reasoning. [[PAGE 5]] Task-specific rubrics and automated grading receive independent expert spot validation.

manual_entries.title: GPT-5.5 System Card: Biological and Chemical Evaluation Update
manual_entries.abstract: The GPT-5.5 system card reports new results and an August correction across public and private biological capability and biorisk evaluations.
manual_entries.body: [[PAGE 22]] The system card contains a biological and chemical benchmark evaluation suite. [[PAGE 23]] ProtocolQA Open-Ended evaluates troubleshooting of published wet-lab protocols. [[PAGE 24]] TroubleshootingBench evaluates identification and correction of realistic execution errors in 52 private expert protocols. [[PAGE 27]] Separate biosecurity evaluations assess dual-use risk, refusal behavior, and agentic capabilities. [[PAGE 4]] An August addendum corrects a protein-binding benchmark score.
